scope: Synthetic local validation only; no real authority, network listener, preview, broker, or deployment
installation_precondition: An approved package installer supporting an explicit temporary target and hash-enforced installation; no active environment or site-packages reuse
runtime_preconditions: A fresh temporary copy of candidate source and separate temporary package target
An allowlisted environment without inherited application secrets or credentials
All application writable paths contained in temporary synthetic storage
Outbound networking, socket bind/listen, and unapproved subprocess execution denied before application imports
Generated test identities and signing keys exist only in temporary storage and are not logged
No disabling of lifespan, authentication, provenance, policy approval or fail-closed guards for a positive startup claim

coverage_intent.tenant_isolation: Signed tenant/body substitutions and adopted policy tenant binding
coverage_intent.replay: One reservation/consumption winner, replay rejection, stale and tampered state rejection
coverage_intent.policy_expiry: Expired policy/adoption and expiry before evidence commit
coverage_intent.concurrency: Concurrent SQLite consumption and cross-process local ledger appends
coverage_intent.audit_integrity: Chain, signature, prior hash, truncated tail and uncertain fsync failures
coverage_intent.local_recovery: Rollback and reopen of the same temporary SQLite files; not platform restart or volume proof
coverage_intent.imports: Import gateway.app and dependencies only under the isolated guarded harness
coverage_intent.startup: Negative startup must reject missing required authority/configuration; positive lifespan needs complete synthetic approved provenance fixtures, not bypasses

existing_test_limitations: Existing endpoint tests instantiate TestClient without a lifespan context and do not prove real lifespan startup
Some endpoint tests replace authority loaders/revalidators with fixtures; report those separately from actual signed-adoption loader tests
Existing helpers and module import-time side effects require a complete isolation review before running
Local process reopen and SQLite/file concurrency do not demonstrate Autoscale consistency or deployment durability
final_evidence: task-local pytest-final.log (kept outside the source changeset)
startup_profile: Explicit production security checks with staging scope; Live-Policy evaluation disabled because current scoped approval contract is production-only
containment: Kernel seccomp blocks IPv4/IPv6 sockets and bind/listen. Python audit guards filesystem and reviewed child processes; not an OS filesystem sandbox.
storage_limits: POSIX cooperating processes on the same tested local filesystem only
Paired writes fail closed on uncertainty; no automatic repair
No platform persistence, distributed consistency or power-loss proof
actual_test_selection_source: task-local pytest-collection.log and pytest-final.log; 16 modules, exact nodeids and parameterization retained outside the source changeset
